question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1
solution:
The correct answer is **"arises".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• *"Not a year passes without a controversy over the national sports awards. The debate that (1)__________ every year following the announcement of the* " As this opening sentence is in the present tense, we need to choose that option which is in V1(base form).
 
• We also need to use that word which we generally use in context with **'happens' **every year.
 
• Out of the given options,** Arises** is the most appropriate word.
 
• **Arises**: to come into existence or begin to be noticed; happen.
 
• Therefore,the correct answer is **option 4.**

**Hence, the correct passage will be-** * Not a year passes without a controversy over the national sports awards. The debate that **arises** every year following the announcement of the (2)__________ often leads to accusations of bias, regionalism and manipulations. (3)___________ to the Sports Minister and Chief Ministers and (4)___________by the politicians have all become part of the (5)_____________. *
